headline: Sensex Jumps 300 Points As Nifty Tops 23,350 Mark
why: Strong buying in realty, metals, and FMCG stocks pushed benchmark indices higher.
Positive corporate developments in pharma boosted selective stock sentiment.
Realty sector surged nearly 2%, providing significant support to the market.
Market participants adjusted positions ahead of the upcoming US Federal Reserve decision.
whatHappening: Sensex touched its day high, gaining over 300 points, while Nifty traded above 23,350.
IT sector faced selling pressure, dragging major tech shares down by over 1.5%.
FSSAI initiated legal proceedings against Nestle India concerning infant nutrition items.
Dr. Reddy's partnered with Takeda Pharma to introduce dengue vaccine QDENGA in India.

summary: Indian benchmark indices traded significantly higher on September 18, with the Sensex gaining over 300 points and Nifty scaling above 23,350. Sectoral gains in realty, metals, and FMCG effectively counterbalanced a steep 1.5% decline in IT stocks ahead of the US Fed meeting. Stock-specific action remained prominent with Dr. Reddy's rising on a vaccine distribution deal and Nestle India facing regulatory heat from FSSAI.
